title: gatk-sv-nextflow pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow reimplementation of the GATK-SV harmonisation pipeline. See nextflow/README.md.

input.description: Sample sheet TSV (family_id, sample_id, bam, bai). See README.md#sample-sheet.

reference_dict.description: Reference genome sequence dictionary (.dict). Required by clustering workflows (GATK4_SVCLUSTER).

primary_contigs_list.description: Plain list of canonical contigs (one per line). Used by Wham (-c).

primary_contigs_fai.description: .fai-format (contig, length, ...) list of canonical contigs. Used by svtk standardize (--contigs) to restrict every caller's output to primary contigs and to build the standardized VCF header. Required by every caller subworkflow.

min_svsize.description: Minimum SV size to retain, applied by svtk standardize (--min-size). GATK-SV default: 50.

manta_region_bed.description: BED of primary contigs + mito, restricting Manta's own calling (--callRegions). Required by workflows/call_manta.nf.

ped.description: Pedigree file for the whole run. See README.md#pedigree-file. Required by clustering workflows.

pesr_exclude_intervals.description: Blacklist BED of intervals to exclude from PE/SR clustering (centromeres etc.). Required by clustering workflows.
